extension_description.message: Save Instagram photos and videos, and X videos, directly to Photos.

popupInstruction.message: Tap the download button beside Send on Instagram or Share on an X video post to save all its media to Photos.

serviceExplanation.message: Videos are processed by your yt-dlp service. Instagram photos are read directly from the post.

tokenPrivacy.message: Your token is kept in extension settings and sent only to your video service.

footerNote.message: Use media you have permission to save. Videos require a running service reachable from this device.

invalidSettings.message: Enter an HTTPS service URL and its access token. HTTP is allowed only on localhost. Clear both fields to remove settings.

servicePermissionDenied.message: Allow Safari access to this service to process videos.

photosFirstSave.message: Photos will ask for access on the first save

photosDenied.message: Allow Photos access for Downloader in Settings

photosRestricted.message: Photos access is restricted on this device

carouselUnavailable.message: Could not read every carousel slide. Open the post, wait for it to load, then try again.

noMedia.message: No downloadable media found in this post.

postURLUnavailable.message: Could not find the post link. Open the post, then try again.

processingVideo.message: Processing video… This may take a few minutes.

retryDownload.message: Tap again to retry failed items.

downloadFailed.message: Download failed. Tap again to retry.

configureService.message: Set the video service URL and access token in the extension popup.

serviceUnauthorized.message: The video service rejected the access token.

serviceTimeout.message: Video processing timed out. Try again.

resolveFailed.message: The video service could not process this post.

nativeUnavailable.message: Downloader could not reach the native app. Enable the extension and reopen Safari.
